description: Democratic Republic Congo (COD) - Mining Sector (2017) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This dataset was extracted from the geodatabase published in 2017 by Resource Matters, as an addition to the energetic sector report in COD: This data has been curated by WB team through consultations with Gov representatives. Coverage: the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
